hero.title: Bring Your Signal
hero.titleCn: Bring your signal onto the bridge
hero.desc: The Call for Proposals for 2026 Community Day Shenzhen is now open. A hard-won production lesson, the evolution of an open-source project, or a leap from engineering into management — if it helps someone else cross the bridge, it makes a great talk.
hero.descClosed: The Call for Proposals for 2026 Community Day Shenzhen closed on 08.31. Thanks to everyone who transmitted a signal — reviews are underway and results will be emailed to submitters.

topics.label: TOPICS
topics.title: Eight Signal Channels
topics.sub: Not limited to the channels below — anything related to cloud computing and developer practice is welcome to transmit.

form.closedBody: Thanks to every bridge-builder who submitted! Reviews are underway and results will be emailed to submitters. Missed this edition? See you on the bridge next year.
form.doneTitle: Your Signal Is on the Bridge 🎉
form.doneBody: We've received your proposal "{{talk}}". Once the review is complete, the organizing committee will reach out by email — keep an eye on the inbox at {{email}}.
form.errorFallback: Submission failed. Please try again later.
form.title: Put Your Proposal on the Review Table
form.phonePlaceholder: Only for urgent contact before the event
form.communityNote: Titles granted by AWS community programs: Community Hero / Community Builder / User Group Leader / User Group Ambassador. No worries if none apply — just leave it empty.

trackHints.ai: Talks on LLMs, generative AI, agents, RAG, and other AI topics.
trackHints.builder: Engineering practice talks: cloud architecture, cloud operations, serverless, IaC, platform engineering.
trackHints.spark: Startups / OPC (one-person company), indie development, tech entrepreneurship, open-source monetization.
trackHints.global: Going global & compliance (security): multi-region architecture, data compliance, cross-border networking, global infrastructure.

form.abstractPlaceholder: What you'll cover, why it's worth hearing, who it's for, and three takeaways the audience can take home
form.bioPlaceholder: Company / role / experience — a sentence or two is plenty
form.note: Submissions go straight into review · results by email
form.privacy: By submitting, you agree that we process your name, email, optional phone, and proposal solely for event review and contact. Data is stored in the organizers' Feishu base and an encrypted backup, retained per the organizers' retention policy after the event.
